name: Module reorder requires remove and include in an authorized transaction

input.fixture_ref: fixture: {setup: "Class C composes Modules A and B, with a private edge authorization for Module A", actions: ["attempt a dedicated reorder API call", "remove A and include A at a new edge position in one authorized transaction", "remove A and attempt to retain host private access through A's Module global state"]}

applicability.reason: Requires dynamic Module edge removal/reinclude APIs and edge-private authorization state beyond the source-only mixin fixture.

expect.status: No dedicated reorder API exists; reorder is possible only via remove plus include with all candidate validation reapplied; removing the edge atomically revokes private authorization, recomputes MRO and lookup versions, and leaves Module global state unable to access host private members.
